Subject: Partner-led technical deep dive — next steps & calendar alignment

Thanks again for taking time today — great to meet the CloudReach team. Quick recap from our discovery and proposed next steps so we can lock in a partner-led technical deep dive/demo: 

- Goal: show a live run of Redwood Dedicated + marketplace connector with a sample integration and discuss routing/tenant isolation patterns you raised.
- Key attendees we think are important: your solutions architect (to validate integration), our infra lead (Vivek), and a product owner to agree on success criteria.

Availability: we can offer two 90-minute slots next week (all times PT):
  * Wed 16 Sep — 10:00–11:30am PT
  * Thu 17 Sep — 2:00–3:30pm PT

If neither works, please share 2–3 windows that do. Also: can you confirm whether you want a sandbox tenant populated with representative config or if a whiteboard-first session is OK? Attached a short MAP-draft for alignment on milestones.

Thanks — I can take lead on scheduling once we confirm a slot.

-- 
Camila Reyes

camila@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Hi Camila — thanks for the clear recap. Wed 16 Sep 10:00–11:30am PT works best for us; Zach and I will attend and well bring one of our integration engineers as well. 

Agenda requests:
- 20m quick recap of objectives / success criteria
- 50m live demo (configured tenant preferred)
- 20m Q&A / next steps (MAP review)

A quick note: our security team will request SOC2 artifact references and an overview of data residency controls after the demo. If you can include a brief 5–10m slide or pointer to those artifacts, that would speed procurement later.

Ive attached a short list of attendees and time zone preference. See you Wednesday.

Best,
